rule: type_answer: at least one accepted answer and none equal once normalized. audioOnly needs lang es and a translation, and its answers must normalize to the spoken text.

cases.name: no-answers
cases.expect: unit-1.json › nodes[0] › lessons[0] › exercises[5] › type_answer: needs at least one accepted answer

cases.name: answers-equal-once-normalized
cases.expect: unit-1.json › nodes[0] › lessons[2] › exercises[5] › type_answer: accepted answers (after normalization) repeat: muy bien y tú

cases.name: listening-in-english
cases.expect: unit-1.json › nodes[0] › lessons[1] › exercises[5] › type_answer: a listening exercise speaks Spanish: lang must be es

cases.name: listening-without-translation
cases.expect: unit-1.json › nodes[0] › lessons[1] › exercises[5] › type_answer: a listening exercise needs a translation

cases.name: listening-answer-differs-from-the-audio
cases.expect: unit-1.json › nodes[0] › lessons[1] › exercises[5] › type_answer: a listening exercise only accepts its own text, not: Sí, gracias.
